The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**: the $20,000 price, less the $5,000 he saved by not finishing, less the $1,000 he got from reselling the materials. Equivalently, he is restored to the $5,000 profit he expected, from his current position of −$9,000 ($10,000 spent, $1,000 recovered). The $3,000 increase in property value doesn't reduce an expectation recovery, and the $9,000 framing cost is already reflected in the calculation.

CONFIDENCE: 72
